description.narrative: Project Outcomes Increased provision of healthcare services and products: This Project will respond to the gap by supporting the BDMG's financing to health companies including health sector SMEs (HSMEs). BDMG will rebuild and operate its health sector-focused financing structure, particularly for HSMEs. Its HSMEs portfolio is expected to grow by more than 60 percent over the next 5 years (current portfolio of USD 10 million) enabling HSMEs in the region to grow their capacity to provide healthcare services and products, thereby improving patient access to healthcare. Stakeholder effects (Access to Finance for SMEs, including WSMEs): The Project will increase access to finance for SMEs, including WSMEs, in the state of Minas Gerais. Credit penetration has been one of the most important issues in financial sector development in Brazil given the structural barriers and lack of incentives for banks to go down market. The Project aims to help address these gaps by supporting BDMG, an institution whose mandate includes targeting more vulnerable parts of Minas Gerais, in increasing its lending to SMEs, including WSMEs as well as SMEs in the health sector, a priority sector for the state. Contribution to Market Creation Competitiveness: Strengthening the competitiveness of HSMEs in Brazil through tailored financing. HSMEs face significant challenges in accessing finance, which hinders their growth. The Project will contribute to promoting the competitiveness of the private health market in Brazil by easing the credit constraints of HSMEs. Improving financing opportunities for HSMEs will: i) promote access to essential healthcare services and products, ii) improve the quality of care, and iii) facilitate innovation in the health sector. BDMG aims to develop a new financing package for HSMEs in the region, which will potentially be supported by IFC's advisory services.

The proposed project consists of an A Loan of up to US 50 million to the Banco de Desenvolvimento de Minas Gerais S.A. The facility consists of an up to 5-year senior unsecured loan, including a 4-year grace period (only for repayments of principal). 50% of the loan will be used for financing the Banks SMEs portfolio (25% to women SMEs and 25% to SMEs located in Minas Gerais municipalities with an HDI of less than 0.754 (Brazils average)), The other 50% will be dedicated to supporting BDMGs Health portfolio.
